imp.generic: The city was alive with noise and movement in the early morning.
imp.author: The city was awake, rawly awake, its cobbles rinsed and glistening, the milkman's cart rattling its thin music down the grey canyon of the street, and everywhere the smell of bread and dung and the cold river coming.

imp.generic: He felt a sudden and overwhelming sense of loneliness.
imp.author: A loneliness came upon him, not the loneliness of an evening or a season but the old loneliness, the loneliness that had always been his, that lived in him like a slow damp in the walls of a house.

imp.generic: She remembered her childhood home with a feeling of nostalgia.
imp.author: She thought of the house—the hall, the oilcloth, the particular brown of the banisters—and something moved in her that was not quite grief and not quite love but was older than either.

imp.generic: It was a cold and grey Dublin morning.
imp.author: Morning came grey and indifferent over the rooftops, over the chimneypots and the pale spires, over the whole dear dirty city that neither forgave nor remembered.

imp.generic: He thought about what she had said and could not forget it.
imp.author: Her words went with him. He turned them this way and that as a man turns a coin, feeling the edges, and still they gave him nothing, and still he could not put them down.

imp.generic: The conversation ended and everyone went home.
imp.author: And then it was over. Coats were found, hands were shaken, the door opened onto the cold and the night swallowed them one by one and the house was left to its silence and its dying fire.

imp.generic: Water is essential to all forms of life on earth.
imp.author: Water: the universal solvent, the womb of the first cell, older than hunger, patient as stone, covering the greater part of the earth's surface and the greater part of man's forgetting.

imp.generic: He walked through the streets feeling disconnected from everything around him.
imp.author: He walked on. Faces passed him and were gone. Shopfronts. A dog. The smell of frying from somewhere. All of it at a great remove, as though he watched it through glass, as though he were already a ghost among the living.

imp.generic: In the end, nothing had really changed between them.
imp.author: So. There it was. The same as it had always been and would always be: the silence between them wide as a field, and each of them standing at their own edge of it, looking across.

imp.generic: He realized that his life had been shaped by forces he never understood.
imp.author: It came to him then—quietly, the way true things come—that he had never chosen any of it, not really, that the nets had been there from the beginning, parish and nationality and the soft persistent voices of the dead, and he had called it living.
